Research in psychology (like the concept of *enclothed cognition*) shows that what we wear can influence how we think, feel, and even behave. It’s also tied to societal associations—suits are worn in high-stakes situations (job interviews, presentations, ceremonies), so they can trigger a sense of "stepping into a role" where you’re expected to perform at your best.
